WITH otif_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    sol.so_line_key,
    sol.promised_ship_date_key,
    ff.ship_date_key,
    sol.qty_ordered,
    ff.qty_shipped,
    CASE
      WHEN ff.ship_date_key IS NULL THEN 'Never Shipped'
      WHEN ff.ship_date_key > sol.promised_ship_date_key AND ff.qty_shipped < sol.qty_ordered THEN 'Both Late and Short'
      WHEN ff.ship_date_key > sol.promised_ship_date_key THEN 'Late Only'
      WHEN ff.qty_shipped < sol.qty_ordered THEN 'Short Only'
      ELSE 'Perfect'
    END AS miss_type,
    sol.item_key
  FROM mro_distributor.o2c_sales_order_line sol
  LEFT JOIN mro_distributor.o2c_fulfillment_line ff USING (so_line_key)
),
otif_by_type AS (
  SELECT
    miss_type,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_total
  FROM otif_analysis
  WHERE miss_type != 'Perfect'
  GROUP BY miss_type
),
late_suppliers AS (
  SELECT
    s.supplier_name,
    s.reliability_tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT oa.so_line_key) AS late_miss_lines,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT oa.so_line_key) * 100.0 / 
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM otif_analysis WHERE miss_type IN ('Late Only', 'Both Late and Short')), 2) AS pct_of_late_misses
  FROM otif_analysis oa
  JOIN mro_distributor.dim_item i ON oa.item_key = i.item_key
  JOIN mro_distributor.p2p_purchase_order_line po ON i.item_key = po.item_key
  JOIN mro_distributor.dim_supplier s ON po.supplier_key = s.supplier_key
  WHERE oa.miss_type IN ('Late Only', 'Both Late and Short')
  GROUP BY s.supplier_name, s.reliability_tier
  ORDER BY late_miss_lines DESC
)
SELECT
  'Miss Type Breakdown' AS section,
  miss_type,
  line_count,
  pct_of_total AS percent
FROM otif_by_type
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Suppliers Behind Late Misses' AS section,
  supplier_name || ' (' || reliability_tier || ')',
  late_miss_lines,
  pct_of_late_misses
FROM late_suppliers;
